name: com.kobapps.buildmanagerkit
description: AAA-quality build pipeline, environment management and CI/CD automation for Unity 6. Reusable per-platform build profiles, first-class dev/stage/prod environments that also apply to the Editor, per-environment defines, identifiers, app icons and config assets, an extensible drag-and-drop pre/post build action system, build queues that survive domain reloads, a searchable build history, and a command line that exposes every build option so CI runs exactly the same pipeline as the button in the window.

samples.description: Examples of custom scriptable pre/post build actions and code based build hooks.
Ready to use GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and Jenkins pipeline definitions.
